payload.summary: Add emit_pressure_state tool to vn-market MCP server. Accepts calendar_status/tick_id/fire_time/pressure_mode/last_regime/last_volatility_level from dispatcher. Server-side computes signal_backlog (ls+grep+wc), dev_queue_depth (jq orch-state), host_headroom_mb (vm_stat/free). Writes docs/data/pressure-state.json atomically (tmp-rename). Promotes cycle-snapshot-HH:MM.json to cycle-snapshot-latest.json if present. Returns {success, emitted_at, pressure_state_path, cycle_snapshot_promoted}. NEVER throws — catches all errors, returns {success:false, reason}. See brief §4 for full contract.
payload.gate: deploy tool BEFORE agent-father patches telemetry.md — sequencing is load-bearing
payload.dod: pressure-state.json written with fresh emitted_at on next cowork FIRE after telemetry.md patch; pressure_mode flips from legacy to adaptive in cowork-team signal
